parameters.query:
WITH ready AS (
  SELECT id FROM content.items
  WHERE org_id = $1
    AND status = 'enriched'
    AND (enrich_result->>'keep')::boolean = true
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE content.items i
SET status = 'fanning_out', locked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
FROM ready
WHERE i.id = ready.id
RETURNING i.id, i.title, i.body, i.canonical_url, i.hero_image_url, i.source,
         i.raw_payload->>'topic' AS topic,
         i.enrich_result;

nodes.name: Pick enriched items
nodes.notes: LIMIT 1 so the downstream 1→N fan-out does not need SplitInBatches. Backlog drains via the 10-min cron. The item stays in transitional state 'fanning_out' until **every** planned platform draft has been inserted (gated by a COUNT subquery in Mark item drafted, driven by plannedCount embedded at Plan per-platform). If LLM/QA fails for one platform, item stays 'fanning_out' and is surfaced by the editorial SLA watchdog (WF 07).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO content.drafts (item_id, org_id, platform, variant_key, body, media_urls, hashtags, status, qa_result, scheduled_at, queued_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8, $9::jsonb, $10, $11)
ON CONFLICT (item_id, platform, variant_key) DO UPDATE
  SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, status, scheduled_at, queued_at;

nodes.name: Save draft
nodes.notes: Idempotent upsert on ux_content_drafts_variant (unique on item_id, platform, variant_key). ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now() is a deliberate no-op update — it does NOT overwrite body/hashtags/status/qa_result so that editor edits in the admin UI are preserved across retries. The reason we switched away from DO NOTHING (round V) is: DO NOTHING returned 0 rows on conflict, so the downstream Draft inserted? IF could not tell the difference between 'first successful insert' and 'retry after Sheet fail with queued_at IS NULL'; the latter case was silently skipping Push to Review Queue on requeue → item stayed stuck in fanning_out forever. DO UPDATE always returns the current row, letting the next IF route on queued_at state.

nodes.name: Needs sheet push?
nodes.notes:
Routes on queued_at NULL (editor not yet visible) vs NOT NULL (already visible OR rejected terminal).

  TRUE  (queued_at IS NULL)   → Push to Review Queue → Mark draft queued → Mark item drafted
  FALSE (queued_at IS NOT NULL)→ Mark item drafted (skip sheet push, idempotent)

Covers all 4 states the retry can land in:
  - pending_review, first insert     → queued_at NULL → push+mark
  - pending_review, Sheet-fail retry → queued_at NULL (preserved) → push+mark (recovery path)
  - pending_review, already queued   → queued_at set → skip (idempotent)
  - rejected, any time               → queued_at set by Shape+QA → skip (terminal)

nodes.name: Push to Review Queue
nodes.notes: X2 (round X): operation changed append → appendOrUpdate. Why: 'append' ignores matchingColumns and blindly appends a row every time. If the Sheets API succeeds but the subsequent 'Mark draft queued' Postgres node fails, the retry loop re-enters here with queued_at=NULL and appends a SECOND row for the same draft_id — editors see duplicates. appendOrUpdate uses matchingColumns=['draft_id'] to upsert: find row by draft_id, update in place; if not found, append once. Retry now idempotent at the Sheet boundary.

parameters.query:
UPDATE content.drafts
SET queued_at = COALESCE(queued_at, now()),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, queued_at;

nodes.name: Mark draft queued
nodes.notes: Confirms the draft is editor-visible by setting queued_at=now() AFTER Push to Review Queue succeeds. If Google Sheets fails, this node never runs → queued_at stays NULL → Mark item drafted's gate excludes this draft → item stays 'fanning_out' until WF07 or manual recovery intervenes. COALESCE guards against re-runs reusing an earlier successful push timestamp.

parameters.query:
UPDATE content.items i
SET status = 'drafted', locked_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE i.id = $1
  AND i.status = 'fanning_out'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content.drafts d
    WHERE d.item_id = i.id
      AND d.variant_key = 'v1'
      AND d.queued_at IS NOT NULL
  ) >= $2::int;

nodes.name: Mark item drafted
nodes.notes: Fires once per platform (~3x per original item). Only the LAST invocation that actually has all plannedCount drafts with queued_at IS NOT NULL flips the item and clears locked_at. The queued_at gate makes partial failures (Google Sheets down, LLM reject, Save draft conflict) visible — item stays 'fanning_out' with locked_at still set, surfaced by WF07's stuck-item query (interval > 30m).
